lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters organized in vertical columns of 4 to 6 nodes, maintaining a roughly equilateral spatial distribution across the mid-flank posterior to the gills.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the circular high-luminance blobs at perpendicular intervals, establishing a grid-like nodal architecture.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features on the upper third of the flank characterized by a high-contrast vertical gradient (specular highlight on the dorsal edge, shadow on the ventral edge).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, high-luminance blobs visible within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, elongated secondary object with distinct ventral shadowing (remora) is attached to the ventral-lateral region below the primary flank patterning.
